featured_reviews.name: Christi K
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Envi Salon, R City.

The entire visit felt more focused on aggressively selling expensive products and memberships rather than creating a good customer experience or a genuine “wow” moment for guests. Every staff member seemed more interested in upselling than actually making the customer feel valued.

I only opted for a gel polish pedicure, haircut, a hair mask application, and threading, yet I ended up paying a shocking amount of ₹8,200. The pricing feels extremely unreasonable for such basic services.

What made the experience worse was the complete lack of transparency. Throughout the appointment, I was repeatedly informed of membership pricing, but nobody clearly informed me that I would be charged full regular prices because I did not have a membership. Finding this out only at the billing counter was extremely unpleasant and misleading.

Considering it was Mother’s Day, it was even more disappointing to see absolutely no special offers, customer appreciation, or hospitality gestures. Other salons like Enrich Salon manage customer experience far better and make clients feel welcomed rather than pressured into spending more.

Overall, this was a very poor experience and certainly not worth the amount charged. Unfortunately, I will not be returning and would not recommend this branch based on my experience. And to top it customer support is asking me to go back to the salon spend more and get 10 percent off as a replacement. Or buy membership.

We are really sorry that you did not have a good experience. We would request you to kindly mail us your registered contact number on feedback@envisalon.in
